q: The golden opportunity you are seeking is in yourself. It is not in your environment; it is not in luck or chance, or the help of others; it is in yourself alone.
Where ever you are, you are one with the clouds and one with the sun and the stars you see. You are one with everything.
Be - don't try to become
People are weird. When we find someone with weirdness that is compatible with ours, we team up and call it love.
If you tell the truth, you don't have to remember anything.
Until you make the unconscious conscious, it will direct your life and you will call it fate.
Nothing can bring you peace but yourself.
If you want peace, you won't get it with violence.
Don't measure yourself by what you have accomplished, but by what you should have accomplished with your ability.
You cannot find peace by avoiding life.
If you want things to be different, perhaps the answer is to become different yourself.
The wisest men follow their own direction.
You can't stay in your corner of the Forest waiting for others to come to you. You have to go to them sometimes.
Success is nothing more than a few simple disciplines practiced every day.
There are more quarrels smothered by just shutting your mouth, and holding it shut, than by all the wisdom in the world.
A man sooner or later discovers that he is the master-gardener of his soul, the director of his life.
Only in the agony of parting do we look into the depths of love.
Courage is what it takes to stand up and speak. Courage is also what it takes to sit down and listen.
Living life in style also means living a life of balance.
Happiness must be grown in one's own garden.
Whatever you do, strive to do it so well that no man living and no man dead and no man yet to be born could do it any better.
What people need and what they want may be very different.
The ego wants comfort and certainty. The soul wants to live fully.
We are shaped and fashioned by what we love.
Everyone sees what you appear to be, few experience what you really are.
Investing in yourself is the best investment you will ever make.
To wish you were someone else is to waste the person you are.
Persistence is very important. You should not give up unless you are forced to give up.
You can't wait for inspiration. You have to go after it with a club.
To find yourself, think for yourself.
One of the advantages of being disorganized is that one is always having surprising discoveries.
We shape clay into a pot, but it is the emptiness inside that holds whatever we want.
Fashion fades, only style remains the same.
Understanding that rests in what it does not understand is the finest.
All things come into being by conflict of opposites.
Intense love does not measure, it just gives.
Public opinion is the worst of all opinions.
The ability to hold two competing thoughts in one's mind and still be able to function is the mark of a superior mind.
The worst part of success is trying to find someone who is happy for you.
If the misery of the poor be caused not by the laws of nature, but by our institutions, great is our sin.
Wake up and smile! Wake up and be grateful!
The fear of death follows from the fear of life. A man who lives fully is prepared to die at any time.
The season of failure is the best time for sowing the seeds of success.
From morning till night, we should never rely on a single thing.
Well done is better than well said.
Ripe fruit falls by itself - but it doesn't fall in your mouth.
The friend is the man who knows all about you, and still likes you.
Nourish the mind like you would your body. The mind cannot survive on junk food.
It matters not who you love, where you love, why you love, when you love or how you love, it matters only that you love.
It's not what you've got; it's what you do that makes the difference.
